summary.text: Sonya Harper is a Democratic member of the Illinois House of Representatives from District 6, in office since 2015, and she is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Sonya Harper assumed office in the Illinois House in 2015 and advanced from the Democratic primary on March 17, 2026.

For 2025-2026 Ballotpedia lists her as chair of the Agriculture & Conservation Committee and a member of the Appropriations-Public Safety, Energy & Environment, Immigration & Human Rights, and Revenue & Finance committees.
Ballotpedia also lists her as chair of the Agriculture & Conservation Committee in the 2019-2020, 2021-2022 and 2023-2024 sessions.
